title: Vertical locally principal subschemes occupy fibre components under the irreducible dominant finite-type and nonincreasing fibre-dimension hypotheses
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The Noetherian argument combines the principal ideal theorem with specialization chains and the fibre-dimension bound. The general case requires a careful finite-type integer-algebra approximation preserving generic invertibility, both fibre dimensions and avoidance of all minimal primes, so that the same contradiction descends.
